narrative.overview:
The intake app is a quiet extension of westscottinc.com: a crew tool that looks like WestScott's own job paperwork rather than a generic SaaS form. Every screen opens under the deep navy header band carrying the circular WestScott logo, then sets white working sheets on a cool light-gray ground. Headings, buttons and labels speak in Roboto Condensed bold uppercase, the same voice as the company site; everything a person reads at length is plain Roboto.

The density is deliberate and roomy for one-handed phone use outdoors: large tap targets (44px minimum, 60px for the send action, 64-68px for the record button), high-contrast ink on white, and a light theme throughout because the primary user is standing in sunlight. Color is sparse. Logo blue does all the action work; brand red is held back entirely for the moment the microphone is live and for things that went wrong. Depth comes from 1px cool-gray rules, not shadows.

It is "same brand, app-clean": calm, task-focused and plainly WestScott, without the marketing site's full photographic look.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy header band with the circular logo on every screen.
White sheets (cards) on a cool gray ground, separated by 1px rules, never shadows.
Roboto Condensed bold uppercase for headings, buttons, labels and status; Roboto for body.
Squared corners: 4px on small parts, 6px on sheets and the main action.
One action color (logo blue); red only for recording and errors.
Light theme only, tuned for sunlight and thumbs.

rules.name: The Red Means Live Rule
rules.body: Signal red appears only when the microphone is recording, when something failed, or on the hover of a remove control. Never on a primary action, heading, badge, or decoration.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Every tappable action is logo blue (filled or as text). Navy and slate are identity colors, not buttons.

rules.name: The Condensed Voice Rule
rules.body: Anything that names, labels or commands (headings, buttons, nav, field labels, badges) is Roboto Condensed uppercase with positive tracking. Anything a person reads as a sentence is Roboto in sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: No content surface carries a shadow. Box-shadow is only used as a state mark (recording pulse, current-page underline).

dos: Do open every screen with the navy header band and the circular WestScott logo.
Do set headings, buttons, labels, hints and badges in Roboto Condensed uppercase with positive letter-spacing (0.05-0.08em; display headlines at -0.01em).
Do use logo blue (#0d4c92) for every action and the 3px focus outline.
Do separate surfaces with 1px cool-gray rules and ground/tint/white tonal steps.
Do keep corners at 4px for small parts and 6px for sheets and the main action; circles only for single-icon controls.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or larger and the main action full-width at 60px.
Do stay on the light theme; the primary user is outdoors on a phone.
Do disable the recording pulse under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use red (#c8151c) for anything but the live recording state, errors, and the hover of a remove control.
Don't use the site's pure brand red #ED1C24 for text; it fails contrast.
Don't put drop shadows on cards, wells, notices or buttons.
Don't round sheets or buttons beyond 6px or use pill shapes for text buttons.
Don't add a dark theme or dark sheets in the working column.
Don't set long-form reading text in condensed uppercase.
